name: Global Quran VR
summary:
Global Quran VR brings the Global Quran reader into your space.

Each verse appears as calm, floating text in your room (or as a book card), in the beautiful Arabic of the mushaf, with your choice of translation and transliteration. Tap to move to the next verse, or switch to Listen mode and let the recitation play while the words arrive one by one.

- Choose any surah and verse
- Translations in many languages, plus transliteration
- Tajweed colour coding, with a full colour key
- Recitation by well-known
